notes: Stage A finds no game concept at all — the author was asked outright and confirmed no genre and no experience design, only a map asset placement — so there is nothing to classify. Stage B is what settles it: the map arrives as two finished asset IDs inserted at the origin at native scale, and the author explicitly ruled out building any ground, boundary, or spawn around them, so there is no space for this pipeline to lay out even though the assets themselves are 3D. That is the P5 determination rather than a silent stop: the caller gets a reason it can show. The axes are left blank because they describe a space being generated, and none is.  I assumed no relative arrangement of the two assets beyond default placement, which is what the author said when asked.
